name: Kashoku no Wana
source:
A beautiful guy enrolls at main character's school club. He accepts protagonist's confession with the condition to get an affair with his brother first. Protagonist clenches teeth and agrees as this is the only way to get access to the body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个漂亮的男人加入了主角的学校俱乐部。他接受了主角的告白，条件是先和他的兄弟发生婚外情。主角咬紧牙关同意了，因为这是进入身体的唯一途径。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
